item: R111 step T2 rest: group, topic and bulletin readers follow the shipped list
key_paths: src/analytics/supergroup_stats.py src/api/insights.py src/analytics/source_topics.py src/analytics/group_stats.py src/analytics/queries.py src/bulletin/coverage.py src/bulletin/stories.py src/bulletin/articles.py
summary: A keyword the shipped stoplist hides no longer counts in a group's totals, its rising test, the Observatory sky or drill-through (the panel's and the sky's resolvers are two functions that agree on the hide rule, pinned by one test, and still differ on ring-term normalisation and first-match-wins, as before), and in the ring-level readers (ring stats, the country split), in the source topics (filtered in SQL with one NOT IN so COUNT(DISTINCT article) stays right), or in the bulletin's coverage columns, story keyword sets and article keywords (dropped before the cut; the coverage fetch widens; two-letter terms leave story grouping, a listing rule). The 13 shipped ring terms already on the list made the curated-group omission wrong. Only the list hides in group and topic readers, not the length rule. AI keywords left on purpose.
